turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. The zero went in before anyone called me, and I want to know why.
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
That's a machine's guess, Hale. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have that page printed in my bag. So what else do you have, or is that it?
I don't need more proof than that.
"I don't need more proof than that." I'm writing that down. Procedure 4.3 says software results do not by themselves establish a concern, so yes, Hale, you do.
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
"Unlike some people." Say who you mean, Hale. My child never lies, and if you're calling me a liar too, I'm writing that down and taking it to the principal.

Then I'll ask you plainly: was Owen spoken to before that zero went in, and who decided? Procedure 4.1 and 4.2 say he is heard and I am called first, and neither happened. If the zero stands, Hale, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
